turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta from Nagpur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Gupta. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is Rohan from the Air Customs clearance wing. We have a luxury watch parcel arriving for you from Dubai, but it is currently held at the hub.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Dubai? I have not ordered any watch, maybe there is some mistake.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is the problem sir, the package contains banned items and your ID is attached, so now it is a legal matter.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Banned items? Oh my god, what will happen now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't worry, I can settle this internally so no police case is filed, but you must pay a clearance fine of twelve thousand rupees immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twelve thousand is a lot of money, can I come to the office and pay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No sir, the office is closed for audit, you must send it via UPI or a Google Play gift card right now to avoid arrest.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know how to do these gift cards, please give me some time.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I only have ten minutes before the file goes to the police, just send the UPI payment to the number I am messaging you now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me ask my son first, he handles these things.
